title: Model listings now include health
summary:
Model listings gained a health signal, while five community apps joined the catalog.

Model discovery responses gained a `health` field by default, with status, success rate, and request count drawn from a rolling 24-hour window. Models without measurements report `unknown` rather than breaking discovery. The API reference was updated to explain the field.

The image app catalog added baboolharech, PersonaMorph, and aaarraaa. PersonaMorph turns photos into artistic personas; baboolharech and aaarraaa are Arabic right-to-left web apps. All three also appear in the README’s recent-apps list.

Oracle Mystique joined the chat catalog with illustrated tarot readings, and Text to speech joined the video/audio catalog. The README also refreshed its Latest News links to point to September 18 announcements.
